f3.title: Assumptions & Sensitivity Analysis
f3.subtitle: Evaluating corridor crowdedness under unrecorded passenger scenarios (0%, 10%, 20%, 30%)
f3.rationale: Under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Yatra Yojana, female commuters travel fare-free via Pink Passes. Because pass holders are not fully recorded in ticketing telemetry, what-if scenarios evaluate sensitivity without inventing a hardcoded multiplier.

actionSheet.title: Corridor Action Sheet for Transit Operators

actionSheet.glossaryDeficitDesc: Hourly unaccommodated passenger demand above nominal bus capacity across scheduled departures.
actionSheet.glossaryExtraTripsDesc: Number of extra bus departures per hour required to bring average passenger load below capacity under each unrecorded rider scenario.
actionSheet.disclaimer: Indicative scheduling model derived from October 2026 ETM sample. Assumes even vehicle spacing and nominal vehicle capacity. Not a live automated dispatch order.
